name: Crownsfall
environment: Warm limestone plaza, blue-gold banners, market terraces
quest: A Bell Without a Ringer: meet archivist Mira Thorne; investigate missing royal courier Joren Pike and a bell heard by only a few citizens.
encounter: Tutorial combat, civic hub, first memory of a vanished courier.

production.layout: Gate → market terrace → bell courtyard → archive; return loop via lower stair.
production.encounter_design: Teach movement on an open practice lane before the market investigation; optional conversations have no combat pressure.
production.storytelling: A bell rope moves without a ringer; courier board has a scraped name.
production.asset_kit: Crown civic kit: limestone, slate, heraldry, awnings, fountains; retain approved camera and HUD.
production.acceptance: Player can find Mira and trigger courier investigation without minimap; safe market is never a combat spawn.

name: Kingsroad Fields
quest: The Missing Mile: escort a grain cart and investigate a road marker whose distance changes.
encounter: Bandits and displaced wildlife; road reappears when a witness names it.

production.layout: Farm gate → wheat lanes → broken aqueduct → shifting milestone → cart turnaround.
production.encounter_design: Escort cart through two ambush pockets; use a wide bypass around overturned wagon.
production.storytelling: Same milestone bears two distances; farm families recount missing road sections.
production.asset_kit: Wheat cards, low stone walls, aqueduct arches, cart, roadside shrine.
production.acceptance: Cart route never crosses enemy spawn point; corrected milestone persists on reload.

name: Bramblewatch
quest: The Last Dispatch: rescue scout Rowan from scavengers at a collapsed bridge.
reveal: Courier carried a black glass seal.

production.layout: Palisade entry → watch yard → orchard path → collapsed bridge rescue → return fire.
production.encounter_design: Rescue Rowan, then hold a short defense at watchfire; provide flank routes around barricades.
production.storytelling: Unsent dispatch pinned to bridge beam; black glass seal clue in dialogue.
production.asset_kit: Timber palisade, watchtower, orchard trees, broken bridge, camp brazier.
production.acceptance: Rowan survives by scripted protected state until rescue resolves; exit opens even if optional enemies remain.

name: Greenwood Marches
environment: Fern forest, streams, ancient root bridges
quest: A Forest Out of Season: follow impossible winter tracks into summer woods.
encounter: Track phase beasts; teach environmental clues.
reveal: An animal remembers an extinct river.

production.layout: Forest edge → stream crossing → seasonal clearing → ancient root bridge → hamlet trail.
production.encounter_design: Follow winter tracks, then fight phase beasts in a clearing with two escape lanes.
production.storytelling: Snow on summer roots; extinct river visible in sediment and beast memory.
production.asset_kit: Fern understory, moss boulders, root bridges, localized snow decals.
production.acceptance: Tracks visible with color-independent shapes and audio; foliage occlusion never hides telegraphs.

name: Mossbell Hamlet
quest: Names on the Door: investigate three households with conflicting memories of a missing child.
encounter: Interview witnesses and clear a haunted mill.

production.layout: Millpond square → three household doors → haunted mill → lantern square.
production.encounter_design: Interview in any order; haunted mill encounter only after gathering evidence.
production.storytelling: Three door plaques disagree about a child; household props support each account.
production.asset_kit: Moss-roof cottages, water edge, lanterns, domestic props, mill interior.
production.acceptance: All interview permutations advance quest; no forced choice of which witness is true.

name: Silverroot Grove
environment: Two overlapping forests, amber leaves suspended
quest: The Unremembered Hunt: Lorecast an old hunter's bow to open a brief echo.
encounter: First stable temporal pocket; fight an echo stag without harming witnesses.

production.layout: Grove entrance → hunter bow → paired anchor clearing → echo stag arena → return anchor.
production.encounter_design: Teach Lorecasting in calm space, then stag dodge/charge pattern with witness exclusion zone.
production.storytelling: Amber leaves freeze; hunter trail occupies same terrain as present path.
production.asset_kit: Shared forest terrain; separate echo foliage, spectral stag, anchor stones.
production.acceptance: Echo entry and return cannot trap player; unlock basic Lorecasting once; witnesses immune to player damage.

name: Ashen Tollway
quest: A Toll Paid Twice: recover the courier's satchel from a road cult.
reveal: Seal belongs to the Keepers of Names.

production.layout: Charred road → wrecked caravan → toll arch → cult barricade → satchel cache.
production.encounter_design: Ambush encounter followed by shield captain; side path supports positional combat.
production.storytelling: Two toll receipts for same traveler; satchel seal matches Keeper mark.
production.asset_kit: Charred wagon, ash decals, toll booth, low ruined walls.
production.acceptance: Satchel pickup available after captain; restart recovers objective if loot interrupted.

name: Bellwater Mills
quest: Water Runs Backward: rescue workers and stop a reversed flood.
encounter: Valve and combat puzzle, mill guardian.

production.layout: Mill village → wheel platform → cellar valves → worker rescue alcoves → spillway.
production.encounter_design: Valve puzzle with fixed safe islands and mill guardian; reverse flood is signposted.
production.storytelling: Water travels uphill across carved anchor marks.
production.asset_kit: Waterwheels, sluice gates, canal modules, wet stone, rescue props.
production.acceptance: Every valve state has reachable safe exit; save restores correct water state and rescued workers.

name: Highward Steps
quest: A Warrant for the Dead: confront Marshal Garran over quarantined relics.
encounter: Gate defense; choose witness dialogue without blocking story.
reveal: Gain authorized access to the lower city.

production.layout: Citadel base → nine-tread approach → gate plaza → Garran checkpoint → lower-city door.
production.encounter_design: Gate defense at broad terrace, dialogue after threat cleared; no narrative branch blocks access.
production.storytelling: Quarantined relic crates and warrants indicate suppression.
production.asset_kit: Use approved Crownsfall architecture; stairs/fountains optional new art only after integration QA.
production.acceptance: Actor feet remain on grade; no collision swap with visual toggles; warrant granted across all dialogue outcomes.

name: Sablemarket Vaults
environment: Merchant crypts, bronze shutters, secret ledgers
quest: The Price of a Name: free a captured Keeper named Tamsin.

production.layout: Market cellar → shuttered vault aisles → ledger room → Tamsin cell → exit stair.
production.encounter_design: Optional stealth route around guards; broker arena with clear lines of sight.
production.storytelling: Ledger dates precede kingdom; names priced as commodities.
production.asset_kit: Merchant shelves, bronze shutters, lockboxes, crypt stone, ledger props.
production.acceptance: Both stealth and combat routes rescue Tamsin; quest-critical ledger cannot be destroyed.

name: Old Crown Cistern
environment: Flooded masonry with flickering original streets
quest: Stones Beneath Stones: drain a chamber and follow an echo of a procession.

production.layout: Cistern ladder → valve platform → lowered-water passage → echoed street → anchor exit.
production.encounter_design: Drain chamber, traverse exposed route, witness procession; small combat pocket on dry ground.
production.storytelling: Current masonry overlays old street plan; matching arch shapes confirm continuity.
production.asset_kit: Flooded cistern modules; duplicate street overlay; water-level meshes and collision variants.
production.acceptance: Switching state from each safe node maintains valid navigation; no submerged spawn or softlock.

name: Undercroft
environment: Buried crypt avenues, candle niches, violet seepage
quest: The Sealed Procession: descend past the Regent's guards.
encounter: Crypt enemy families; unlock shrine waypoint.
reveal: A royal guard protects a door.

production.layout: Guarded hatch → crypt avenue → candle shrine → guardian door → cathedral entry.
production.encounter_design: Crypt patrols and short defense; unlock shrine checkpoint before boss approach.
production.storytelling: Royal guard heraldry appears before character identity is known.
production.asset_kit: Buried stone, niches, crypt gates, violet seepage, shrine marker.
production.acceptance: Checkpoint reload preserves authorized descent; cathedral entrance visible from shrine.

name: Cathedral of the Nameless
environment: Violet ruined nave, shattered stained glass
quest: The Man Behind the Monster: defeat Ser Caldrin Vael, then Lorecast his shield.
encounter: Boss with defensive stances; mandatory quiet memory of wife Elara Vael and daughter Lys.
reveal: The apparent monster was an erased father.

production.layout: Nave entry → side aisles → central arena → quiet shield memory alcove → anchor door.
production.encounter_design: Ser Caldrin defensive stance boss, readable windups; stop combat and music before mandatory family memory.
production.storytelling: Shattered glass depicts ordinary family; shield reveals Elara and Lys, not generic monster lore.
production.asset_kit: Gothic nave, broken stained glass, armor, shield, warm historical memory variant.
production.acceptance: Boss completion always yields shield memory; no loot prompt or enemy interruption during reveal.

name: First Anchor Chamber
environment: Huge bronze rings under the cathedral, floating inscriptions
quest: The First Anchor: align Caldrin's name with the courier's seal; resist the Hollow Choir.
encounter: Anchor sentinel boss; stabilize and rescue Joren Pike, whose recent displacement is reversible.
reveal: The missing courier returns; Engine is alive and the present has a deadline.

production.layout: Bronze ring approach → name alignment stations → sentinel arena → courier rescue → exit.
production.encounter_design: Align Caldrin’s name with seal, defend anchor; rescue Joren after stable state.
production.storytelling: Inscriptions respond to individual names, not royal seal; recent displacement reversible.
production.asset_kit: Bronze rings, readable inscriptions, floating glyphs, separate combat-safe walkways.
production.acceptance: Correct input order validated; anchor state persists; courier rescue and next quest never duplicate.

name: Crownsfall Citadel
environment: Royal court, gathering refugees, dusk over city
quest: The King's Silence: present proof to Regent Maera; defend the court from a small reality tear.
encounter: Public reveal and siege finale; permanent hub refugee changes.
reveal: Receive warrant to investigate the outer scars.

production.layout: Citadel court → proof presentation → refugee terrace → tear defense → west departure.
production.encounter_design: Court dialogue leads to small siege with civilians protected; finish with public consequences.
production.storytelling: City refugees and changed guards show present-world stakes.
production.asset_kit: Reuse city hub; add dusk lighting, barricades, shelters, banners and tear VFX.
production.acceptance: Refugees appear after finale on all saves; Act II warrant unlocks Westgate Refuge; prior hub travel remains available.
